data.purpose: Numbers, IDs, dates, and code only.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation of the paper sheet from the desk.

motion.name: seal-press
motion.purpose: Single authored stamp-press animation; reduced-motion mode is static.

components.name: Sheet Frame
components.description: Paper document with double printed frame.
components.html:
交付紀錄

工作項目與驗收結果
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; max-width: 76rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 2rem; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet); } .ds-sheet::before, .ds-sheet::after { content: ''; position: absolute; pointer-events: none; inset: 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-form); } .ds-sheet::after { inset: calc(1rem + 4px); border-width: 1px; }

components.name: Section Bar
components.description: Form heading with optional count and action.
components.html:
工作經歷

03查看項目
components.css: .ds-section-bar { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-form); } .ds-section-bar h2 { flex: 1; margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink); font: 700 1.5rem/1.25 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', serif; } .ds-section-bar [data-data] { color: var(--color-form); font: 0.8125rem 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-section-bar a { color: var(--color-form); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-section-bar a:hover, .ds-section-bar a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Printed label and entered value on paper.
components.html: 職稱資深工程師
components.css: .ds-field { padding: 0.7rem 1rem 0.9rem; background: var(--color-paper); } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; color: var(--color-form); font: 0.75rem/1.3 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-field-value { color: var(--color-ink); font: 1.0625rem/1.55 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Ruled record row that stacks with labels on narrow screens.
components.html: 01資料匯入已完成
components.css: .ds-ledger { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-ledger th, .ds-ledger td { padding: 0.8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); text-align: start; } .ds-ledger td + td { border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--color-line); } @media (max-width: 40rem) { .ds-ledger thead { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-ledger, .ds-ledger tbody { display: block; } .ds-ledger tr { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.75rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.6rem 0.75rem; padding: 1rem 0.85rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); } .ds-ledger td, .ds-ledger th { grid-column: 2; padding: 0; border: 0; } .ds-ledger th { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 6; } .ds-ledger td::before { content: attr(data-label); display: block; color: var(--color-form); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } }

components.name: Seal Mark
components.description: State-bearing stamped mark; shape conveys status without color.
components.css: .ds-seal { display: inline-block; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; color: var(--color-seal); transform: rotate(-4deg); } .ds-seal svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-seal text { fill: currentColor; font: 700 14px 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-seal:hover { transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1.02); } .ds-seal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-form); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: Compact document masthead navigation with ruled active state.
components.html: 關於經歷
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-nav a { padding: 0.6rem; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--color-ink-soft); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { border-bottom-color: var(--color-form); color: var(--color-ink); }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a completed acceptance form: a sheet on a desk, printed furniture, filled-in information, and a restrained hand-stamped sign-off. The visual language is orderly and legible, with a quiet distinction between the form's printed structure and its recorded content.
keyCharacteristics: A centered paper sheet with a printed double frame.
Form rules and labels use form ink; content uses readable ink.
Seal geometry carries status, with cinnabar reserved for seals.

rules.name: The Seal-Only Red Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar belongs to seal marks, not links, headings, or controls.

rules.name: The Recorded-Data Rule
rules.body: Do not set ordinary prose in mono; reserve it for identifiers and machine-like values.

dos: Do keep printed form structure in form ink and entered content in ink.
Do carry the same paper/form logic into dark mode: it is a carbon copy at night, with desk, paper, rules, and text all retuned together.
Do let seal shape communicate state even without color.
Do preserve keyboard focus visibility and the reduced-motion static state.
donts: Don't add cards, pills, or badges.
Don't add eyebrow labels or gradient text.
Don't use hard shadows or emoji icons.
